📱 Open ProfRev properly

This screen is a file preview (from WhatsApp, Files or Mail), which shows the page but does not run apps, so ProfRev cannot start here.

On iPhone or iPad: open octrainhash.github.io/profrev in Safari, then Share → Add to Home Screen. It then works offline too.

On a laptop: unzip ProfRev.zip and open the app in the Windows, Mac or Linux folder, or open the link above in Chrome or Edge.
